series.name: All EcoStar AC splits & floor-standing — shared platform (Bijli Bazar 2026 table)
series.notes: EcoStar (Pakistan — support via DWP Home: 042-111-111-97 / 033-171-113-97, info@dwphome.pk). Verified on ecostar.com.pk: inverter and non-inverter wall splits (Crown line appears in videos), floor-standing Iceberg/Glacier/Glory-style units and large-capacity EFS; no dedicated FS/cassette code sources found — one shared platform file. ONLY full written EcoStar list = Bijli Bazar 'Ecostar AC Error Code List 2026' (single source → medium for the table; official EcoStar Facebook makes EL high and non-fault). Official troubleshooting YouTube exists (@EcostarPk) but code values are JS-gated. No official EcoStar/DWP service manual with a fault table found. Cross-brand trap: EcoStar's E1/E2/E4/E5 mapping differs from Gree — Gree OEM tables are NOT imported even though a Gree-like platform is plausible. Reset: remote OFF → breaker OFF 5–10 min → breaker ON → remote ON.

meaning.en: EL is the Energy Limit / Power Limit mode indicator — a deliberate operating mode, not an error.
meaning.ur: EL Energy Limit / Power Limit mode ka indicator hai — jaan bujh kar chalne wali mode, error nahi.

causes.en: Power Limit Mode was turned on (user setting)
causes.ur: Power Limit Mode on kar di gayi thi (user setting)

solutions.en: Turn Power Limit Mode off and restart the unit
solutions.ur: Power Limit Mode band karein aur unit restart karein

solutions.en: Or press AMP.C on the remote 8 times
solutions.ur: Ya remote par AMP.C 8 baar dabayein

source.title: EcoStar official Facebook — 'Seeing EL on your EcoStar AC display…'

notes.en: Official EcoStar Facebook clarification — EL is a mode, not a fault. Prevents technicians from chasing a non-error.
notes.ur: Official EcoStar Facebook clarification — EL mode hai, fault nahi. Technicians ko non-error ke peeche bhaagne se bachata hai.

title.en: Outdoor Pipe / Coil Temperature Sensor Fault
title.ur: Outdoor pipe / coil temperature sensor ki fault

meaning.en: The outdoor pipe/coil temperature sensor is faulty or disconnected.
meaning.ur: Outdoor pipe/coil temperature sensor kharab ya disconnect hai.

causes.ur: Mausam se sensor wiring damage
Connectors corroded

solutions.en: Switch off the AC at the breaker and wait a few minutes before touching the outdoor sensor wiring; nothing should be probed while the unit is live.
solutions.ur: Pehle AC ko breaker se band karein aur kuch minute ruk jayein, phir outdoor ki sensor wiring check karein; unit live ho to koi bhi probing na karein.

solutions.en: Remove the outdoor unit cover and follow the pipe/coil sensor wire from the board to the coil: look for rodent bites, broken or chafed wire, moisture and green corrosion on the connector, and make sure the sensor plug is pushed fully into its socket.
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit ka cover kholein aur board se coil tak sensor ki taar dekhein: chuho ka katta hua, toota ya ghis hua taar, connector par nami aur hari zang, aur sensor ka plug poori tarah socket mein laga hai ya nahi — yeh sab check karein.

solutions.en: With the supply still off, measure the sensor with a meter and compare the reading against a normal room-temperature value; if it reads open, short or far off, clean a corroded connector or replace the sensor, then restore power and confirm the code clears.
solutions.ur: Supply band rahe, meter se sensor naapein aur reading ko normal room temperature se milayein; open, short ya bohat alag aaye to connector saaf karein ya sensor badlein, phir power wapas on karke confirm karein ke code khatam ho gaya.

meaning.en: System pressure is out of safe range — leak or wrong charge.
meaning.ur: System pressure safe range se bahar — leak ya charge ghalat.

causes.ur: Refrigerant ka leak hona
Kam/zyada charge

solutions.en: Stop using the unit and switch off the mains straight away; running with pressure out of range can overheat and damage the compressor.
solutions.ur: Unit chalana band karein aur foran mains off kar dein; pressure range se bahar chalte hue compressor garam hokar kharab ho sakta hai.

solutions.en: Check the indoor coil, the flare joints and the outdoor service valves for oil stains, damp patches or a hissing sound; oil marks or hissing show where the gas is escaping.
solutions.ur: Indoor coil, flare joint aur outdoor service valve par tel ke nishan, gilli jagah ya seeti jaisi awaaz dekhein; tel ke nishan ya seeti se pata chalta hai ke gas kahan se nikal rahi hai.

solutions.en: Do not just top up the gas: have a technician pressure-test and vacuum the system, repair the leak, then weigh in the correct charge; if the pressure was high instead, switch off, let the unit cool, clean the condenser and confirm the outdoor fan runs before restarting.
solutions.ur: Sirf gas na barhayein: technician se system ka pressure test aur vacuum karwaein, leak theek karwayein, phir sahi charge daalein; agar pressure zyada tha to unit band karke thanda hone dein, condenser saaf karein aur restart se pehle outdoor fan chal raha hai, yeh check karein.

meaning.en: The compressor drive/inverter stage failed — needs immediate professional repair.
meaning.ur: Compressor drive/inverter stage kharab ho gaya — foran professional repair zaroori hai.

causes.ur: IPM/drive kharab ho jana
Compressor ka electrical hissa kharab

solutions.en: Switch off the mains and leave the unit off; do not keep restarting it, because repeated starts on a failed drive can burn out the compressor as well.
solutions.ur: Mains band karke unit ko aise hi rehne dein; baar baar restart na karein, kyunke kharab drive par baar baar start karne se compressor bhi jal sakta hai.

solutions.en: Have a technician inspect the outdoor main/inverter PCB for a burnt smell, a blown fuse or a damaged IPM/IGBT, and measure the supply reaching the board with a meter after the power is isolated.
solutions.ur: Technician se outdoor main/inverter PCB par jali hui boo, uda hua fuse ya kharab IPM/IGBT check karwayein, aur power alag karke meter se board tak jaane wali supply naap lein.

solutions.en: Check the compressor winding and the board-to-compressor connectors for a short, an open winding or loose plugs; replace the part that fails this check (drive board or compressor wiring), then power up once and confirm the code does not return.
solutions.ur: Compressor ki winding aur board se compressor tak ke connector check karein ke short, open winding ya dhila plug to nahi; jo part is check mein fail ho (drive board ya compressor wiring) woh badlein, phir ek baar power on karke confirm karein ke code wapas nahi aaya.

meaning.en: Code H1 appears only as a Bijli Bazar page tag implying it exists on some EcoStar units; no meaning, cause, or solution is published anywhere found.
meaning.ur: Code H1 sirf Bijli Bazar page tag par hai jisse maloom padta hai ke kuch EcoStar units par mojood hai; kahin bhi meaning, cause, ya solution publish nahi mila.

causes.ur: Available sources mein meaning publish nahi

causes.en: A protection or sensor input tripped and the board mapped it to this code — which input it is, no source states.
causes.ur: Kisi protection ya sensor input ne trip kiya aur board ne isay is code par map kiya — kaun sa input hai, yeh koi source nahi batata.

causes.en: Code mapping is model-dependent: the same display string can mean something else on another EcoStar or Gree-platform model.
causes.ur: Code ka matlab model par depend karta hai: wahi display string doosre EcoStar ya Gree-platform model par alag ho sakti hai.

solutions.en: Power off and note the exact display pattern
solutions.ur: Power band karein aur exact display pattern note karein

solutions.en: Technician should map the code from the model service chart — do not guess (Gree H1=defrost, Lc=startup, P-series=test-freq are cross-brand hints only)
solutions.ur: Technician model service chart se map kare — andaza na lagayein (Gree H1=defrost, Lc=startup, P-series=test-freq sirf cross-brand hints hain)

solutions.ur: Power band karein aur exact display pattern note karein

solutions.en: Technician should map the code from the model service chart — do not guess (Gree H1=defrost, Lc=startup, P-series=test-freq are cross-brand hints only)
